tray.title: Tray rack
tray.hint: Pick a slot then press Auto run, or scan a code to let the machine find the slot. Green has room, amber nearly full, red full.
slot.title: Slot {slot} — X {x} mm, Z {z} mm, tips {dir}
order.qrHint: Scan this to pull the order and its SKU list.
viz.title: 3D model
viz.subtitle: follows the real position of the 3 axes
viz.hint: Drag inside the frame to rotate, double-click to reset the view. The green tray stays level along the way, then tips into the right row. The target slot glows amber.
cycle.title: Cycle
btn.homeHint: LIMIT is the sensor point, fixed by the mechanics — the machine returns there after every power cut or STOP. HOME is where it rests between cycles: jog to the spot you want, press Set HOME here, and it will return there after every tray.
step.300: manual tip to a set angle
alert.faultTail: Check the mechanism, press Clear fault, then Go to LIMIT.
alert.stoppedMidway: The previous cycle stopped midway. Check the position and run again.
alert.hitLimit: An axis stopped at a limit switch. The cycle did not finish — clear the obstruction and run again.
hint.0x8400: Bad motion command parameter — check the coordinates sent down.
hint.0x8402: Speed is over the axis Max velocity set in TIA. Lower the speed on the Settings page, or raise Dynamics → Max velocity in TIA and reload.
hint.0x8403: Acceleration is over the axis Max acceleration set in TIA.
hint.0x8404: Jerk is over the limit declared in TIA.
alert.notHomed: Not homed — press "Go to LIMIT" before running.
cfg.title: Rack dimensions
cfg.intro: Enter only one basket’s size and the two axes’ travel. The slot count, each row’s height and every slot’s coordinates are computed by the server and written straight to the PLC table. No hand-typed coordinates, no per-slot teaching.
grp.basket: The basket — changing these re-lays the whole grid
grp.travel: How far the three axes travel
grp.speed: Speeds — pushed straight to the PLC, no TIA needed
grp.mech: Drive parameters — must match the Technology Object in TIA
cfg.tiltHint: The tipping angle must stay under the Axis_Y software limit ±{limit}° — change it in the drive parameters below.
fld.dwell_ms: Settle time at the basket, ms
fld.tilt_hold_ms: Hold at the tipping angle, ms
grp.park: Park position — where the machine waits between cycles, at the sensors
cfg.saveHint: Save is all it takes: the server stores the configuration, re-computes the coordinate table and syncs it to the machine. Nothing else to press.
cfg.pushAgainHint: The automatic sync failed (machine busy or offline), or the block was just reloaded in TIA:
sync.failed: Not in sync — {reason}. Tap Sync again.
derived.title: Conversions — cross-check with TIA
manual.title: Manual — only for machine setup
manual.note: These buttons skip the auto cycle. For probing coordinates and checking the mechanism, not for production.
manual.slotHintNone: Pick a slot on the Operate tab first.
jog.title: Manual jog
jog.subtitle: hold to move, release to stop
jog.speedNote: Runs at the speed set on the Settings page —
jog.speedNoteTail: If it feels right when you try it, leave that number for automatic runs.
sensor.label: Sensors:
sensor.hint: Block a sensor slot and watch which pin turns ON — that is the one. The program currently uses I0.0 to home X and I0.1 to home Z.
sensor.waiting: not sent by the PLC yet (reload FC_StatusPack)
log.title: Log
cmd.parkHere: Set HOME at the current position
cmd.pushTable: Re-push the whole table to the PLC
cmd.busy: Skipped "{label}" — a command is still running
cmd.wipeAsk: Wipe all stock figures for the 20 slots?
slots.readFail: Could not read the slot table: {err}
cfg.newLayout: New layout: {slots} slots — {rows} rows × {cols} cols × 2 sides
cfg.orphans: Layout shrank, slots {list} dropped out — remember to empty them
